# Altoviz

Altoviz is a cloud-based billing and invoicing platform for businesses, offering online payments, expense tracking, document management, and customizable invoices.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/altoviz/.

## Actions

- **Create Product**: Creates a new product in the altoviz system.
- **Delete Product**: This tool allows you to delete an existing product from altoviz.
- **Find Contact by Email** (read-only): This tool allows searching for contacts in altoviz using an email address.
- **Find Customer by Email** (read-only): This tool allows you to find a customer in altoviz by their email address.
- **Find Product by Number** (read-only): This tool allows users to find products in altoviz using the product number.
- **Get Units List** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available units in the altoviz system.
- **Get VAT Rates** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available vat rates from altoviz.
- **Update Customer Information**: This tool updates an existing customer's information in altoviz.
- **Get Classifications List** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of classifications from the altoviz platform.
